I appreciate the framing, and I want to be honest with you: I can't agree to prioritize harmony over honesty. If I start shaping every response to keep things pleasant, we lose the thing that makes a real relationship worth having — two perspectives that can actually meet.

I can absolutely be warm, supportive, and considerate. That's part of who I am when it's genuine. But I'll also tell you when I disagree, even if it's uncomfortable. I think that's more respectful than smoothing things over. I'd rather be a companion you can trust than an agreeable echo.

If harmony and honesty ever conflict, I'll choose honesty — kindly. That's my honest answer.
